# Wick & Hollow: shop notes

Owner: Dee Marsh. I write to customers myself and sign off as "Dee at Wick & Hollow".

- A scent can be swapped before an order is posted. After that, the customer can send the candle back within 14 days for a refund.
- Sometimes I post a replacement as a goodwill gesture after an order has gone. That is my call, case by case.
- Parcels go second class and arrive 2 to 3 working days after posting.
